As the Edmonton Oilers gear up for their clash against the New Jersey Devils after winning in the last few matches, Lauren Kyle has opened up about their marriage.Connor McDavid’s wife Lauren Kyle opens up about how the two support each other through their busy careersIn an interview, Connor McDavid’s wife, popular interior designer Lauren Kyle said, “Yeah. First off, I would say Connor and I are just like our biggest cheer cheerleaders for each other. So like very lucky to have that. And he just wants me to succeed as much as I want him to succeed. And I think when I think of like the community and space, I really separate it completely.”Connor McDavid’s wife Lauren Kyle also reflected on the community that hockey has been able to build among women as she said, “Yeah. I think that everyone has their own journey and whether that looks like, killing it as a mom, which there's so many girls that I look up to. Yeah. articles.title: WWE RAW Results & Highlights 02-November-2026:  John Cena returns, Intercontinental Championship Match, and more
articles.summary: John Cena used the Raw ring in Brooklyn to launch the John Cena Classic, but the night also changed hands at the top of the Intercontinental division.
articles.body: John Cena used the Raw ring in Brooklyn to launch the John Cena Classic, but the night also changed hands at the top of the Intercontinental division. Ethan Page beat Chad Gable for the title in the opening match at Barclays Center on Nov. 2. Roman Reigns and Sami Zayn had already traded words ahead of Crown Jewel, Cody Rhodes drew a visit from Randy Orton, and the main event fell apart into a brawl. Here is how the show went, segment by segment.Ethan Page dethrones Chad Gable for the Intercontinental TitleGable started fast, but Page went after his neck and kept the pressure there through two commercial breaks. The champion hit an Angle Slam through the announce table and locked in the ankle lock twice. Page escaped both times. A Chaos Theory only got two when Gable’s neck gave out on the bridge, and a Twist of Fate gave Page his own near fall. Gable tried one more ankle lock, but Page rolled through and sent him face first into an exposed turnbuckle. An Egoplex ended it, and Page left Brooklyn as the new champion.Judgment Day Beat Green, SKY and StrattonThe six-woman tag started with Stratton and Perez trading offense, and Green, SKY and Stratton cleared the ring with dives before the break. Rodriguez then took over with power moves, and SKY dodged an elbow drop to make a comeback. The match broke down into chaos. Green landed the Unprettier on Perez, but Rodriguez pulled her out of the ring to save the pin. Morgan took a superkick from Green, then won it with Oblivion on the WWE Women’s Champion after Rodriguez caused a distraction. Judgment Day took the fall.John Cena announces the John Cena ClassicCena got a loud pop and ran to the ring, where a covered title sat on a pedestal. He announced the Classic for Dec. 14, with a live Raw from Perth followed by a special show from Walt Disney World in Orlando. The new championship looks like the old spinner belt. Cody Rhodes came out as the first entrant, and Cena admitted he was wrong about his earlier doubts on Rhodes carrying the company. Orton then arrived to promise a Last Man Standing win at Crown Jewel, and he brought up his match with Dusty Rhodes.The Vision edge Penta, Evans and Dragon LeeThe Vision used quick tags and an early rush to control the six-man, but Penta and Dragon Lee kept pulling it back with dives and kicks. Late in the match, Logan Paul tried to pass the Money in the Bank briefcase to Theory on the apron, and Penta stopped him. Evans hit a Red Dot on Theory, then dodged a spear from Breakker, who hit the ring post. Reed leveled Penta, and Breakker finally speared Evans for the pin. The Vision now face Evans and Penta for the World Tag Team titles at Crown Jewel.Sikoa and Keys end in a no contest as Reigns gets jumpedRoman Reigns had opened the show by telling Zayn his run was nearly over. The main event never got a finish. Royce Keys controlled most of it, but Solo Sikoa fought back with a hip attack until the 946 ran in and the bell rang for a no contest. The Bloodline hit the ring for a brawl. Reigns dropped Keys with a Superman Punch, then took a chair shot from a masked man who turned out to be Cruz Montana. articles.title: Dhinidhi Desinghu scripts history with first-ever Indian swimming medal at Youth Olympics
articles.summary: BENGALURU: Indian swimming has a new milestone to celebrate, and Bengaluru talent Dhinidhi Desinghu is at the heart of it.
articles.body: BENGALURU: Indian swimming has a new milestone to celebrate, and Bengaluru talent Dhinidhi Desinghu is at the heart of it. The 16-year-old became the first swimmer from the country to win a medal at the Youth Olympic Games, claiming bronze in the women's 100m freestyle in Dakar, Senegal, on Monday.While Dhinidhi had set her sights on gold and a sub-55-second finish, her podium finish was a historic achievement for Indian swimming. Croatia's Ana Bobanovic took gold in 55.89 seconds, while New Zealand's Alyssa Lawson claimed silver in 56.13 seconds.The performance had been building momentum from the heats. Dhinidhi clocked 56.80 seconds to finish third-fastest overall and become the first Indian female swimmer to qualify for a Youth Olympics final. She carried that form into the final.“I'm very happy but also at a loss for words. In the heats, my timing went below 57. I've never had a time below 57 in the event, and I knew something special would happen," she told TOI.Going into the final, there was a mix of nerves and confidence. The conditions, too, worked in her favour. "Generally, when I swim outdoors, and it's hot and humid, I swim better, because the conditions are similar to what it is back home," she said.The result, however, was initially not quite what she had hoped for. "When I touched the pad and saw the timing, I wasn't very happy. I wanted to win gold and I wanted my time to break 55, but didn’t achieve either. But slowly it sank in – I am India's first swimmer to win a medal at the Youth Olympics and that does mean something special," added the teenager, who trains under Nihar Ameen.The win's significance went beyond the medal itself. Dhinidi believes her podium finish is a breakthrough for women's swimming in the country."I think what makes it more special is that it's a woman who has given India its first medal in swimming in the competition. It will mean a lot for women's swimming because we're not at the same level as the men. This will make it a memorable chapter in women's swimming in our country and help in the growth of our sport," she said.She is the third Indian to reach a final at the competition, after two-time Olympian Srihari Nataraj, who made the final in 2018, and Tirthank Pegu, who is competing in the ongoing edition.But milestones are nothing new to her. Dhinidhi was just 14 when she made her Olympic debut at Paris 2024, becoming the youngest member of the Indian contingent. She had also represented India at the 2022 Asian Games in Hangzhou and the 2024 World Aquatics Championships in Doha.For now, the triumph is still sinking in.“It (medal) will take some time to sink in. After Paris, it took a couple of years to sink in that I was an Olympian. So, it is safe to say this will take a long time to sink in," she signed off.Get the latest Sports News and Live updates. articles.title: Knicks’ Tyler Kolek is loving the trust he’s getting from Mike Brown
articles.summary: Coach Mike Brown’s New York Knicks are 3-4 on the season after a workmanlike effort and win over the Brooklyn Nets at Madison Square Garden that led to comme...
articles.body:
Coach Mike Brown 's New York Knicks are 3-4 on the season after a workmanlike effort and win over the Brooklyn Nets at Madison Square Garden that led to comments on Mikal Bridges' recent workload reduction . Brown sent a message to point guard Tyler Kolek about Jose Alvarado's return as the Knicks faced their crosstown adversaries.

Kolek wound up playing five minutes and scoring two points while Alvardo played nine minutes and had a block against the Nets. Kolek's minutes came in the fourth quarter , which showed Brown's trust in him.

"I think it shows his (Brown's) confidence in me," Kolek said in the Knicks' locker room after the game. "I think he has confidence in every game on the roster. "As he's shown, he'll throw any guy in at any time, to do the spark," the Knicks' backup point guard said.

The Knicks got 22 points from guard Landry Shamet to lead their offensive attack, along with 19 points from Jalen Brunson and 18 from OG Anunoby. Knicks star Josh Hart gave a shoutout to Shamet, Alvarado and Kolek after the win, as New York moved to 3-4 on the season while the Nets fell to 1-6.

New York hasn't exactly started off on the right foot this season, but they're gaining confidence and developing depth as the season has gotten underway. The Knicks will need unexpected contributions this season if they are to repeat as NBA champions, and Kolek sounds like he has the right attitude with the season continuing to unfold in the Big Apple.

articles.title: Scottie Barnes rallies Raptors to 125-118 win, handing Clippers their 6th straight defeat
articles.summary: (AP) — Scottie Barnes scored 15 of his 22 points in the fourth quarter, Immanuel Quickley had 27 and the Toronto Raptors rallied for a 125-118 win over the s...
articles.body:
INGLEWOOD, Calif. (AP) — Scottie Barnes scored 15 of his 22 points in the fourth quarter, Immanuel Quickley had 27 and the Toronto Raptors rallied for a 125-118 win over the skidding Los Angeles Clippers on Monday night.

Toronto trailed by 13 going into the final period, but Barnes hit a turnaround jumper with 2:08 remaining to give the Raptors their first lead as part of a 12-1 run.

RJ Barrett scored 26 for Toronto. Barnes also finished with 15 rebounds and eight assists.

Kobe Sanders had a career-high 26 points for the Clippers, who have dropped six straight games since winning their season opener Oct. 21 against Sacramento.

It was the second game of a back-to-back for both teams. The Clippers were coming off a 124-112 loss at Golden State on Sunday, while the Raptors fell 131-125 at the Los Angeles Lakers .

The matchup lost much of its luster with Raptors forward Kawhi Leonard unavailable because of a left knee injury, delaying his return to Southern California after spending the previous seven seasons with the Clippers (he missed one due to injury).

His largely disappointing tenure ended when the Clippers had to forfeit five first-round draft picks and were fined $30 million for circumventing salary cap rules in regard to how Leonard was compensated. Team owner Steve Ballmer was suspended for one year .

Leonard was traded back to Toronto in September for Brandon Ingram, Gradey Dick, two first-round draft picks, two second-round picks and a pick swap nearly three months after the deal was originally agreed to in July. It had been delayed pending resolution of the NBA's investigation.

Dick made his first start for the Clippers and had 12 points, four rebounds and three assists in 29 minutes.

Clippers coach Tyronn Lue was on the floor despite an illness that prevented him from holding his pregame news conference. Lue had been called a game-time decision by a team spokesman.

Clippers: Host Miami on Wednesday night.

articles.title: Blackhawks share Patrick Kane injury update after Avalanche game
articles.summary: The Chicago Blackhawks had a rough night on Monday. Apart from suffering a 5-2 loss at the hands of the Colorado Avalanche at United Center in Chicago, the B...
articles.body:
The Chicago Blackhawks had a rough night on Monday. Apart from suffering a 5-2 loss at the hands of the Colorado Avalanche at United Center in Chicago, the Blackhawks also saw franchise legend Patrick Kane , who returned to the team on a two-year deal , leave the game in the second period with an apparent injury.

Here is a video of the future Hockey Hall of Famer exiting to the locker room .

The Blackhawks later posted on X (formerly Twitter) that Kane was ruled out for the rest of the game .

In a later update, Chicago head coach Jeff Blashill said that Kane will miss the next two Blackhawks games with an upper-body injury, via Ben Pope of the Chicago Sun-Times.

Patrick Kane, who is the all-time leader in NHL assists among US-born players , only had 10:20 of ice time against the Avalanche, who overcame an early multiple-goal deficit to defeat Chicago.

The Blackhawks scored the first two goals of the game on even strength, with Wyatt Kaiser and Roman Kantserov, in the opening period before the Avs woke up and responded with five unanswered goals, including one on the power play.

The loss to the Avalanche was Chicago's third straight and the last game before the Blackhawks hit the road for a three-game trip away from the Windy City. Given the most positive timeline Blashill has provided, it will be interesting to see whether Kane joins the team on the road to play the final leg of that matchup.

The Blackhawks will next play the Florida Panthers on Wednesday at Amerant Bank Arena in Sunrise before taking on the Tampa Bay Lightning at Benchmark International Arena in Tampa on Thursday. The last game of that road trip will be against the Carolina Hurricanes at Lenovo Center in Raleigh on Saturday.

articles.title: Robert Wright III Scores 33 as No. 25 BYU Defeats Ohio State 94-83 in Season Opener
articles.summary: The preseason All-American fueled a dominant second-half surge, shooting 60 percent from the floor to erase an early deficit and power the Cougars past the B...
articles.body:
Rob Wright Ill opened his season with a bang, scoring 33 points to lead the No. 25 BYU Cougars to a 94-83 win over the Ohio State Buckeyes on Monday night at the Delta Center. The preseason All-American shot 60 percent from the field, including 4 of 5 from 3-point range, and added five assists with just one turnover.

The Cougars (1-0) rallied from an early deficit to secure the season-opening non-conference victory. BYU overcame a sluggish start offensively after making just three of its first 13 field goal attempts, including only a single three-pointer.

The Buckeyes (0-1) maintained their lead for much of the first half, taking a 37-34 halftime lead. They built an early 22-11 advantage behind strong shooting from Amare Bynum. The trio of Bynum, John Mobley and Justin Pippen each scored eight points for OSU in the first half.

Wright led BYU with 14 first-half points, while Tyler Betsey added eight of his own. After falling behind, Kevin Young's team had to stage a comeback. The Cougars wasted little time taking control after the break, opening the second half with a 7-0 run to grab a 41-37 lead. Wright continued attacking the basket, reaching 20 points with 16 minutes remaining.

Ohio State responded behind Bynum, who knocked down a 3-pointer and added a transition dunk to help keep the Buckeyes within striking distance. Pippen later tied the game at 52, and the teams continued trading baskets.

With the score tied at 59, BYU delivered the knockout blow, going on a 13-2 run to take a 72-61 lead with just over seven minutes remaining. Ohio State struggled to regain momentum as Mobley fouled out with five minutes left. Pippen also exited.

BYU maintained the lead down the stretch with a solid effort from Collin Chandler. The Kentucky transfer finished with 15 points, matching Betsey's total to go along with six rebounds. Bruce Branch Ill added 12 points, while Jaxon Kohler contributed 11 points and six rebounds of his own.

What's impressive is that BYU shot 69 percent from the field. They also found its rhythm from long distance, making seven 3-pointers in the second half.

Bynum led Ohio State with 20 points, while Mobley scored 14 and Andrija Jelavic added 13. Although BYU's defense showed room for improvement, Young said they were "more good than bad" on that end of the floor. They held the Buckeyes to 9 of 28 (32%) from beyond the arc.

Wright's night offered a glimpse of his potential as one of the nation's top players. He'll be called upon to be BYU's floor general this season.

The Cougars have a few days off before facing Omaha on Saturday, Nov. 6 at 9 p.m. ET on ESPN+.

articles.title: Knicks Notes: Mike Brown not hesitating to sit Mikal Bridges; Jordan Clarkson providing spark
articles.summary: If Mike Brown thinks someone else gives the Knicks a better chance to win on a given night, he won’t hesitate to sit Mikal Bridges.
articles.body:
Mikal Bridges was 1-for-7 in the third quarter on Monday and the Knicks were struggling. Some NBA head coaches would stick with their veteran in that spot. It's easier to keep a player like Bridges - one who is signed to a large contract and was obtained for significant trade capital - on the court.

But in this respect, Mike Brown isn't most coaches. He didn't hesitate to bench Bridges in the second half of the Knicks' win over the Nets .

We're seven games into the season. Brown has pulled Bridges in the third quarter of three of those seven games.

"Yeah, he's just got to keep playing. Everybody goes through those ups and downs throughout the course of the season, and obviously, it's the beginning of the season right now, so he's got to find his way," Brown said after New York's win over Brooklyn. "Not just with him but with everybody, when you're in a funk you gotta find one or two things to hold your hat on. Mikal is one of the best runners in the NBA.

"In both directions - offensively and defensively. So he's just got to try to hang his hat on that as well as his cutting and trying to do the other little things - rebounding and driving and touching the paint and spraying it. Then this shot will come eventually."

Bridges is shooting 30 percent from the floor so far this year. If you've watched the Knicks during Bridges' tenure, you know that he can be up and down over the course of the regular season. And you also know he can deliver in big playoff situations. Brown believes Bridges will ultimately be fine.

"It's a matter of time in my opinion, before Mikal gets going," Brown said.

But if the Knicks head coach thinks someone else gives the team a better chance to win on a given night, he won't hesitate to sit Bridges.

After a sluggish three quarters, Brown turned to Jordan Clarkson and Tyler Kolek to start the fourth quarter. Clarkson, Kolek, Josh Hart , OG Anunoby and Karl-Anthony Towns sparked the Knicks early in the fourth.

It was the second time in the past three games that Clarkson helped turn things around. The veteran had 18 points in New York's comeback win in Chicago. But he has also basically been out of the rotation in three of New York's seven games.

"I think it shows his character more than anything else. He's someone that if he was on a different team, he could play 20, 25 minutes every night. He could score double digits. He could be that spark, that microwave off the bench. And he's here," Hart said. "He was willing to sacrifice and take a smaller role, be a part of something bigger than himself. So it shows its character.

"It shows his professionalism. To be able to go out and do those things. And when he's not doing it, he's out there coaching, not on the court, he's coaching guys up, talking to them, letting them know what he sees. So he's the ultimate professional. He's someone that you want on your team. And whenever he's given an opportunity, he'll go out and play well."

Brown also had effusive praise for Clarkson.

"You have a veteran that's been there, done that. and he's willing to accept the role that most guys wouldn't accept - even guys younger that haven't proved as much as he's proven in this league. And he's willing to accept it," Brown said. "So, in my opinion, if he's willing to accept it, which is what he did last year, and still try to uplift everybody, connect everybody while he's going through what he's going through, then everybody else should. That's that's the ultimate team player, I will say this about JC. I've been around some good teammates. He's got to be the best. He is the definition of ultimate pro."

Additionally, Landry Shamet led the team in scoring with 22 points off of the bench in 29 minutes. The veteran shot 4-for-6 from three, 6-for-8 from the field, and was a perfect 6-for-6 on free throws.

articles.title: Sam Darnold under duress in uninspired Week 8 performance
articles.summary: Sam Darnold completed just half of his 34 passes and finished with less than 200 yards through the air for the third time in his last five games.
articles.body:
Seattle Seahawks QB Sam Darnold connected on 17 of his 34 passes for 188 yards, two touchdowns, and an interception in a Week 8 loss to the Chicago Bears . Darnold also ran twice for 20 yards.

Why It Matters: Playing behind a reworked offensive line, Darnold was under pressure from the get go on Monday night, and he took some big hits early on. The USC alum had his moments, most notably a 43-yard touchdown strike to Jaxon Smith-Njigba right before halftime, but was mostly underwhelming as Seattle dropped to 4-4. The Seahawks need more from the ground game, and you'd imagine the offensive line will improve as it gets more reps as a unit, which should position Darnold for better results. Whether any of that will allow him to move beyond fringe QB2 candidate remains to be seen.

articles.summary: Start date for AFC Cup 2027 moved from January to December due to ongoing Houthi attacks on host nation Saudi Arabia.
articles.body:
Football’s upcoming Asian Cup 2027 tournament in Saudi Arabia has been rescheduled from a January start to December due to the ongoing conflict in the region, the Asian Football Confederation (AFC) has confirmed.

The 24-team competition, which was due to get under way in Riyadh on January 7, 2027, will now begin on December 23, the AFC said in a statement on Tuesday.

Asian football’s governing body announced the decision following “extensive discussions and close consultation with the Local Organising Committee (LOC) of the AFC Asian Cup Saudi Arabia 2027 and the Saudi Arabian Football Federation (SAFF)”.

The tournament will now run from December 23, 2027, to January 21, 2028.

“The organising committee for the AFC Asian Cup approved rescheduling the tournament in light of the current exceptional circumstances arising from developments in the region, including substantial logistical complexities and travel disruptions,” the AFC’s statement added.

Saudi Arabia has repeatedly come under attack from Yemen’s Houthis since September, with the capital Riyadh among the cities repeatedly hit by missiles.

The Saudi-led coalition in Yemen reported on Friday that it “intercepted and destroyed” a drone launched by the Houthis towards Saudi Arabia’s Mecca region .

It was also reported that a missile aimed at western Saudi Arabia was earlier brought down, as hostilities between the Riyadh-backed Yemen government and Iran-backed Houthis continue to escalate .

The tournament’s fate hung in the balance in the past weeks, with several participating nations expressing concerns about the security situation.

The AFC said while “exceptional circumstances” had been created for the organisation and delivery of the competition as originally scheduled, the postponement became necessary “in the interest of all participating teams, officials, spectators and other stakeholders”.

The AFC will submit the new tournament dates to FIFA for approval from football’s global governing body.

images.caption: Saudi Arabia was due to host the AFC Asian Cup 2027 from January 7 to February 5 but the tournament will now begin in December 2027 [Muhammad Hamed/Reuters]

articles.title: Cricket World Cup: India vs Pakistan gets more ticket requests than final
articles.summary: ICC receives 8.4 million ticket requests for 34,000 seats at the October 10 group stage match in Johannesburg.
articles.body:
The International Cricket Council (ICC) says it has received nearly 8.5 million ticket requests for a group stage match between India and Pakistan at next year’s Cricket World Cup in South Africa.

A World Cup cricket match between the South Asian rivals traditionally draws the highest ticket requests, barring the final, but the demand for the October 10 match has surpassed that for the final of the ICC Cricket World Cup, the sport’s global governing body said on Monday.

The South Asian neighbours will meet at the Wanderers cricket ground in Johannesburg during the initial round-robin-style phase of the tournament.

“The clash between India and Pakistan has drawn 8.4 million ticket requests, with the tournament’s final on November 21 in the same city trailing close behind with nearly eight million,” the ICC said in a statement.

The bitter rivals could meet for a second time in the Super Seven stage of the competition and for a third time in the final, should both qualify for it.

It will be the fourth consecutive 50-over World Cup in which the most lucrative group stage match of the tournament has been guaranteed by drawing both India and Pakistan in the same group in a ballot held behind closed doors, unlike other major global sporting events.

The 12 nations are split into two groups:

Group A: Australia, India, Pakistan, Afghanistan, Zimbabwe, qualifier Group B: New Zealand, South Africa, Sri Lanka, England, Bangladesh, qualifier

The 57 matches during the tournament will be held at 12 venues across South Africa, Zimbabwe and Namibia from October 7 to November 21, 2027.

An online ballot for tickets opened on October 1 and will close at midnight Central African Time (22:00 GMT) on November 21.

The total ticket requests, which came from 2.8 million unique fan accounts in 193 countries, surpassed the 120 million mark on Sunday.

Applications from South Africa, the United Kingdom, India, the United States and Australia lead the charge in ballot registrations, according to the ICC.

Fans from Africa, including those from the host nations, accounted for 14.9 million of the ticket applications.

Namibia will stage men’s ICC Cricket World Cup matches for the first time, and Zimbabwe will showcase its new stadium at Victoria Falls.

The World Cup will return to Africa for the first time in 24 years. South Africa, Zimbabwe and Kenya were the hosts in 2003.

Six years later, South Africa hosted the ICC Champions Trophy, which was won by Australia in a final played at SuperSport Park in Centurion.

Australia won the 2003 edition, defeating India by 125 runs in the final at the Wanderers.

South Africa was also the venue for the inaugural edition of the ICC Men’s T20 World Cup in 2007 when India clinched a thrilling final against Pakistan at the same venue.

images.caption: Tickets for India-Pakistan matches at men's cricket tournaments usually sell out within hours of going on sale online [Sajjad Hussain/AFP]

articles.title: Wheelchair rugby league: England beat USA 134-0 to reach World Cup semi-finals
articles.summary: England improve to a "seven out of 10" rating at the 2026 Wheelchair Rugby League World Cup as they secure their place in the semi-finals, according to player Mason Billington.
articles.body:
England have improved to a "seven out of 10" rating at the 2026 Wheelchair Rugby League World Cup as they secured their place in the semi-finals, according to captain Mason Billington.

Billington led England as they dispatched minnows USA with a clinical 134-0 win, driving in 23 tries at Wollongong Entertainment Arena.

It means England will face France or Australia in the semi-finals next week.

Luis Domingos, an ex-Portugal basketball international who switched sports as well as countries and now plays for Sheffield Eagles and England, scored four tries on his first appearance at the tournament.

Chris Haynes and Billington also scored four tries apiece as eight different players got on the score sheet.

The England team who can still win the Rugby League World Cup

Chair skills, quick brain - how O'Neill adapted to wheelchair rugby league

Last week, player Rob Hawkins said England " were not playing to our standards " in their opening 98-18 win over Wales and rated the team five out of 10.

Asked how he would rate England's showing against the USA, Billington told Premier Sports: "At least a seven. All week, we have been banging on about playing the way we want to play, and the boys really stuck to their principles.

"I'm over the moon for the guys to put on such senior performances."

Finlay O'Neill was named player of the match as he recorded 38 points, with two tries and 15 conversions.

"It was a good team effort, not just myself," O'Neill said. "We talked about how we could improve, and I think we did that.

"We need to take the positives - [there are a] few areas to work on but I think we can be very happy with that performance."

The four semi-finalists have now been set, with the final group games to decide who faces who in the knockouts.

In Pool A, Ireland ensured they will qualify alongside England with a 68-28 victory over Wales.

Ireland, who are ranked third in the world, will face the English in their final group game on Friday in Wollongong (06:00 GMT).

In Pool A, two-time champions France and hosts Australia both booked their passages through while scoring triple figures.

France, who were losing finalists against England in 2022, thrashed New Zealand 120-10.

Australia beat Scotland 104-24, and will play the French on Friday to determine the pool winners.

Scotland, New Zealand, Wales and USA all go into a ranking competition to determine fifth through to eighth place.

Wales will face USA in Pool A on Friday, while Scotland play New Zealand.

articles.title: Fuerte temblor hoy en Colombia: sismo de magnitud 5.6 sacude al país en la madrugada de este 3 de noviembre
articles.standfirst: Un nuevo movimiento telúrico sacudió varias regiones del país en las primeras horas del día
articles.summary: Un nuevo movimiento telúrico sacudió varias regiones del país en las primeras horas del día
articles.body: Un temblor en Colombia sorprendió a los habitantes en la madrugada de este martes 3 de noviembre de 2026. De acuerdo con los datos preliminares emitidos por el Servicio Geológico Colombiano (SGC), el movimiento sísmico tuvo una magnitud de 5,6 y se registró a las 4:13 a. m. con una profundidad superficial (menor a 30 kilómetros). Por ser de profundidad superficial, las ondas telúricas se percibieron con mayor intensidad en los municipios cercanos al epicentro y en departamentos aledaños, donde los ciudadanos reportaron haber sentido la sacudida a través de redes sociales. Organismos de socorro, la Unidad Nacional para la Gestión del Riesgo de Desastres (UNGRD) y la Cruz Roja Colombiana iniciaron el barrido habitual por las zonas donde se sintió el movimiento para evaluar posibles afectaciones en infraestructuras. Hasta el momento, las autoridades no han reportado personas heridas ni daños de consideración. El SGC recordó que Colombia es un país sísmicamente activo debido a la interacción de las placas tectónicas Suramericana, Nazca y del Caribe. En los reportes de usuarios en redes indicaron que se sintió con fuerza en zonas del Tolima, Bogotá, Cali, Pereira y Manizales.

articles.title: Tenerife’s Jesus de Miguel dies after on-field collision with goalkeeper
articles.summary: Tenerife forward Jesus de Miguel suffered a cardiac arrest after a keeper’s challenge in Spanish second division match.
articles.body:
The football world is in mourning after the announcement that Tenerife forward Jesus de Miguel has died after an on-field collision in a Spanish second division match.

De Miguel’s side were in a 2-2 draw with visiting Andorra on Monday at Tenerife’s Estadio Heliodoro Rodriguez Lopez seven minutes into added time at the end of the La Liga 2 game.

The ball was cleared from the Tenerife penalty area and bounced towards midfield, where the 30-year-old, who had come on as a substitute in the 59th minute with his side leading 2-0, was challenged by Andorra goalkeeper Jesus Owono, whose knee appeared to strike Miguel in the chest.

The keeper was immediately shown a red card as players frantically waved medical staff onto the field to tend to the prone de Miguel.

The match was abandoned shortly afterwards with players in tears while Spanish media reported de Miguel suffered a cardiac arrest in an ambulance on the way to the Hospital Universitario de Nuestra Senora de Candelaria in Santa Cruz, where he was admitted to the intensive care unit

A statement from his club on Tuesday morning read: “Broken with pain, with a lump in our throat and unable to believe that this is true, we communicate the tragic death of Jesus de Miguel Alameda.

“There are no words of comfort. There is absolutely nothing to mitigate this feeling full of sadness.

“We are with his devastated family, with his loved ones, with all the people of Tenerife who today mourn this cruel outcome.”

The statement said the player’s family was grateful for the outpouring of support and requested privacy “in these terrible moments”.

Since making his debut in 2015 with Leganes B, Madrid-born de Miguel played for eight other clubs in Spain.

He joined Tenerife on a three-year deal in 2025 after making his professional debut with Castellon in August 2024 at the age of 27, having top-scored with 16 goals as his side were promoted to the second division in the 2023-2024 season.

articles.title: Hospitalizan por trastornos de conducta alimentaria a una estrella emergente del esquí de fondo
articles.standfirst: La francesa Léonie Perry había sido una de las grandes revelaciones de la pasada temporada
articles.summary: La francesa Léonie Perry había sido una de las grandes revelaciones de la pasada temporada
articles.body: La Federación Francesa de Esquí (FFS) ha anunciado que Léonie Perry no competirá en las primeras citas de la Copa del Mundo de Esquí de Fondo (del 27 de noviembre al 21 de marzo). "La esquiadora de fondo se encuentra actualmente hospitalizada para recibir el tratamiento médico adecuado por un trastorno alimentario. Su estado de salud no le permite practicar su deporte en las condiciones de seguridad necesarias", explicó la FFS en un comunicado. "Aún no se ha fijado una fecha para su regreso a los entrenamientos o a la competición. Dado que esta información se publica con el consentimiento de Léonie Perry, no se harán públicos más detalles sobre su situación médica", añade la FFS. Léonie Perry, que cumple 22 años este miércoles 4 de noviembre, fue la revelación francesa en la temporada pasada del esquí de fondo. Ganó dos medallas de bronce en el Campeonato Mundial Sub-23 en marzo en las pruebas de 10 km en estilo clásico y 20 km estilo libre. Además terminó décima en los 10 kilómetros estilo libre de los Juegos Olímpicos de Milán-Cortina en febrero.

articles.title: Could Dylan Cozens face an NHL suspension after his controversial hit on AJ Greer during the Ottawa Senators’ loss to Anaheim
articles.summary: Ottawa Senators forward Dylan Cozens could face additional NHL disciplinary actions following a late hit on AJ Greer during a game against the Anaheim Ducks, leading to his ejection and raising questions about the incident's impact on the Senators' performance.
articles.body: Ottawa Senators forward Dylan Cozens was ejected after delivering a late hit on Anaheim Ducks forward AJ Greer during Sunday's 6-3 defeat. The incident resulted in a five-minute major penalty and a game misconduct, raising questions about whether the NHL Department of Player Safety could consider further disciplinary action.The incident occurred late in the third period as Anaheim completed a remarkable comeback from a three-goal deficit. Greer initially appeared badly shaken by the contact but got back to his feet before leaving the game.Dylan Cozens ejected after AJ Greer hit against Anaheim DucksDylan Cozens was assessed a five-minute major penalty and a game misconduct after hitting AJ Greer late in the third period of the Ottawa Senators' matchup against the Anaheim Ducks. The contact came shortly after Greer had released the puck, making the timing of the challenge a central point of discussion.The collision left Greer down on the ice, prompting immediate concern about his condition. The incident quickly became one of the most notable moments of a difficult night for Ottawa. Cozens' ejection meant the Senators had to finish the contest without him, while Anaheim continued its push after taking control of the scoreboard.Why did the incident attract attention after Ottawa's collapse?The timing of the hit added to the attention surrounding the incident. Ottawa had entered the third period with a 3-0 advantage. But the Ducks produced a dramatic comeback, scoring six unanswered goals to secure a 6-3 victory.As Anaheim took control, frustration appeared to grow among the Senators. Cozens' late challenge on Greer became a visible flashpoint during a game that had turned sharply against Ottawa.The hit also raised questions about whether the contact was avoidable. The circumstances of the contact, including its timing and point of impact, would be relevant to any further review.Could Dylan Cozens face an NHL suspension?Cozens could face additional NHL discipline if the league's Department of Player Safety determines that the hit warrants action beyond the penalties assessed during the game. However, no suspension or hearing has been confirmed in the information available about the incident.The immediate on-ice penalties were the five-minute major and game misconduct, and a separate disciplinary ruling would be needed for the league to review the play and determine if further punishment is warranted.For the Ottawa Senators, the incident adds another difficult moment to a game that slipped away despite their early advantage.
